whyOutlierDiagnosis.primaryDriver: This video outperformed the creator's median (1,455 views) by 5.6x because it zeroes in on "Emotional Confidence Recovery & Male Baldness Solution". It avoids vague promotional claims and provides tangible visual confirmation.
whyOutlierDiagnosis.retentionHookReason: Leveraged Personal Vulnerability & Emotional Relief (Raw First-Person Story). In short-form video algorithms, videos that establish an emotional or visual curiosity gap in the first 2 seconds achieve above-average completion rates.
whyOutlierDiagnosis.engagementTrigger: Generated a 3.4% total engagement rate (205 likes, 73 comments). High comment participation signals strong viewer interest, prompting recommendation algorithms to push the video beyond existing followers.
whyOutlierDiagnosis.algorithmSignal: Averaging ~274 views/day over 29.5 days active. The platform algorithm detected high replay rates and comment dwell time, sustaining distribution.
